title: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
1. Short title, extent and commencement.‑‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Baluchistan Orphanages (Supervision &
Control) Ordinance, 1976.
(2) It extends to the whole of Baluchistan except the
Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come into force on such date as the
Government may by notification in the official Gazette appoint in this behalf.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Definitions

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
2. Definitions.‑In this Ordinance, unless the
context otherwise requires‑
(a) "Board" means a Board constituted under
section 3 of this Ordinance ;
(6) "Chairman" means the Chairman of the Board ;
(c) "Government" means the Government of
Baluchistan ;
(d) "Governing Body" means a person or group of
persons responsible for the management and control of an Orphanage ;
(e) "Licensing Authority" being the Director/
Deputy Director, Social Welfare, Baluchistan or any other officer appointed or
nominated by him to be a Licensing
Authority for the purposes of this Ordinance ;
(f)
"Member" means, a member of the Board ;
(g)
"Orphan" means any child under the age of 18 years who‑
(i) has lost his/her parents or one of the parents and has
no adequate source of income ; or
(ii) is unclaimed ; or
(iii) has parents who are destitutes or who has bean
deserted by his parents ;
(h) "Orphanage" means a building, structure or
enclosure or any institu tion or part thereof which is used for the reception,
maintenance and care of Orphans. The Orphanage in future will be named as
"Darul Itfal";
(i) "Prescribed" means prescribed by the rules
framed under this Ordinance ;
(i) "Secretary" means the Secretary of the Board
;
(k) "Rules" means the rules made under this
Ordinance a and
(1) "Voluntary Social Welfare Agency" means an
organization association or undertaking established by a person or group of
persons for rendering welfare services and depending for its resources on
public subscription, donations or Government aid and registered under the
Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1961.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Establishment of the board

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
3. Establishment of the Board.‑As soon as may be,
after the commence ment of this Ordinance, Government shall, by notification in
the official gazette, establish a Board to be called "the Baluchistan
Board of Control for Supervision and Control of Orphanages "

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Membership  of the board

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
4. Membership of the Board.‑‑(1) The Board
shall consist of a Chairman and the following members :‑ ,
(a) Secretary, Finance Department, Baluchistan ;
(b) Secretary Auqaf Department, Baluchistan ;
(c) Secretary, Education Department, Baluchistan ;
(d) One representative of the Chamber of Commerce and
Industry, to be nominated by it ; ,
(e) One representative of the Home Department to be
nominated by Government ;
(f) Cane representative of the Law Department to be
nominated by Government ;
(g) Director/Deputy Director, Social Welfare, Baluchistan.
(h) Two prominent Social Workers to be nominated by the
Chairman in the manner stated in subsection (4) of this section;
(2) The Additional Chief Secretary (Co‑ordination)
shall be the Chairman of the Board and shall act as such in his individual
capacity.
(3) The Director/Deputy Director. Social Welfare,
Baluchistan shall be the ex officio Secretary of the Board.
(4) The Chairman shall, on the recommendation of the
Secretary nominate two prominent social workers mentioned in clause (h) of
subsection (1) of section 4 from amongst Voluntary Social Workers who may be
willing to act as members of the Board and be deemed fit by the Chairman to
hold that assignment.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Temporary vacancies

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
5. Temporary Vacancies.‑(1) If for any reason, the
Chairman becomes unable to perform his duties temporarily, Government shall
nominate any other member to act as Chairman till such time the Chairman
resumes his duties.
(2) In case the office of Secretary falls temporarily
vacant, the Govern ment may nominate any other member or officer of the Board
to perform the duties of the secretary during the subsistence of the vacancy.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Notification of the chairman and nominated members

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
6. Notification of the Chairman and nominated members.‑(1)
The nomination of the Chairman and members shall be notified in the official
Gazette.
(2) Any alternation in the membership of the Board,
including termina tion or resignation by all of any one of the members shall
take effect from such date as may be specified in the notification.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Meetings  of the board

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
7. The meetings of the Board shall be held at such time
and place and in accordance with such procedure as may be prescribed;
Provided that until rules are made, the meetings of the
Board shall be convened and conducted by the Chairman at such times and in such
manner as he may consider fit.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Employees  of the board

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
8. Employees of the Board‑The Board may far the
purposes of official performance of its functions or exercise of its powers
appoint such employees as it may consider necessary on such terms and
conditions as may be prescribed;
Provided that such terms and conditions shall be fixed in
accordance with such directions as the Government may, in case of its
employees, issue from time to time:
Provided further that until rules are framed, the Board
may appoint employees on ad hoc basis on such terms and conditions as it may
deem fit.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Functions  of the board to be public servants

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
9. Functionaries of the Board to be public servants.‑The
members of the Board, its employees and every person empowered by the Board to
exercise any of its powers under this Ordinance shall be deemed to be public
servants within the meaning of section 21 of the Pakistan Penal Code.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Delegation of powers

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
10. Delegation of Powers ‑The Board may delegate to
the Chairman or to any of its members or employees all or any of its powers
under this Ordinance or the rules made thereunder.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Fund

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
11. Fund.‑(1) There shall be a fund of the Board
called the Baluchistan Orphanages Fund.
(2) The fund shall consist of
(a) all money received by the Board from Government ;
(b) all money collected through Zakat, Fitrah, donations,
charities and other contributions ; and
(c) all money received or collected under this Ordinance
as fee, etc.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Custody audit and operation of fund

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
12. Custody, Audit and operation of fund.‑The Fund
shall be‑
(i) Kept in any scheduled Bank in the manner prescribed ;
(ii) Operated by the Secretary under the directions of the
Chairman ; and
(ii) subject to inspection and audit in the manner
prescribed.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Functions  of the board

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
13. Functions of the Board.‑The functions of the
Board shall be‑‑
(a) to formulate policies with regard to the objectives of
the Board ;
(b) to plan, co‑ordinate, integrate, evaluate and
encourage welfare services for orphans in Baluchistan ;
(c) to supervise arid regulate the working of orphanages
by giving them professional, technical and financial assistance;
(d) to perform any other functions entrusted to it by or
under any law ; and
(e) to control the raising and utilization of funds by executive body of orphanages and to
arrange for their audit.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Prohibition to establish or continue on orphanage without a licence

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
14. Prohibition to establish or continue an orphanage
without a licence.---- No person or a Voluntary Social Welfare Agency shill
establish or continue an Orphanage except under a licence issued by the
Licencing Authority;
Provided that a person or a Voluntary Special Welfare
Agency continuing an Orphanage on the date of commencement of this Ordinance
may obtain a licence within thirty days of the said date.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Separate orphanages for males and females

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
15. Separate Orphanages for males and females.‑‑‑(1)
There shall be separate orphanages for males and female.
(2) A person or a voluntary Social Welfare Agency applying
for a licence to run an Orphanage shall mention in the application whether the
orphanage for which the licence required is a male or female orphanage.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Issue of licence

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
16. Issue of licence.‑On receipt of an application
fir issue of a licence in the prescribed form alongwith a fee at the rate of R3. 50 per Orphanage,
the Licencing Authority shall hold inquiry to find justification for the
opening or continuance of an Orphanage and may issue a licence on such terms
sad conditions as may be prescribed.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Renewal suspension or cancellation of licence

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
17. Renewal, suspension or cancellation of licence.‑A
licence issued under section 16.‑
(i) shall be valid for a period of two years from the date
of its issue ;
(ii) may, when an application is made on the prescribed
form within a week of the date of the expiry of the licence, be renewed by the
Licencing Authority without fee for a further period not exceeding two years at
a time - and
(iii) may, after giving the licensee an opportunity of being
heard, be suspended or cancelled.
Licensing Authority, if there is any contravention of any
of the provisions of this Ordinance or any breach of the conditions of the
licence.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Appeal

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
18. Appeal.‑Any person aggrieved by an order under
sections 16 and 17 may prefer an appeal to Government within sixty days from
the date of such order and the decision of the Government thereon shall be
final.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Medical examination of orphans

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
19. Medical Examination of Orphans.‑The Governing
Body of an Orphanage shall have every orphan, admitted into the orphanage.
medically examined within seven days of such admission and thereafter shall
have to continue such practice once a year and keep a record to this effect in
the prescribed form.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Prevention of begging

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
20 Prevention of begging ‑The Governing Body of an
Orphanage shall in no circumstances allow or cause an orphan admitted into an
Orphanage to beg for alms or solicit for donation or subscription in any way or
form nor shall such an orphan be made or permitted to act in any manner incom patible
ordinary human dignity.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Penalties

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
21. Penalties.---‑Whoever contravenes any provision
of this Ordinance shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which
may extend to three years but which shall not be less than one year, or with
fine which may extend to two thousand rupees, or with both.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Maintenance and inspection of accounts

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
22. Maintenance and Inspection of accounts.‑(I) The
Governing Body of an Orphanage shall maintain or cause to be maintained
accounts of income and expenditure of Orphanage in the manner prescribed.
(2) The Board or any person authorised by it in this
behalf may inspect the accounts of an Orphanage and issue such directions as it
may deem necessary and the Governing Body shall carry out such directions.
(3) The Governing, Body of an Orphanage shall be bound to
produce or cause to be produced its record before the Board or the Licencing
Authority or its nominee as and when required.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Exemption

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
23. Exemption.‑Nothing in this Ordinance shall apply
to any orpha nage established or managed be Government.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Power to make rules

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
24. Power to make rules.‑(l) Subject to the
provisions of this Ordinance and with the approval of the Government the Board
may make rules, for the purpose of carrying into effect the provisions of this
Ordinance.
(2) In particular and without prejudice to the generality
of the foregoing power such rules may provide 'or all or any of the following
matters namely: ‑
(a) the procedure to be followed at the meeting of the
Board ;
(b) the terms and conditions of service of the employees
of the Board ;
(c) the powers and duties of the Chairman, Secretary and
the members of the Board ;
(d) the form of the application for issue or renewal of
licences ;
(e) the form and condition on which licences may be issued
;
(f ) the form of making report of medical examination and
admission of Orphan ;and
(g) any other matter which may be considered necessary for
carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: Baluchistan Orphanages Supervision and Control Ordinance 1976
sections.description:
Repeal

BALUCHISTAN ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
BALUCHISTAN
ORPHANAGES (SUPERVISION & CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1976
25. Repeal.‑‑The West Pakistan Control or
Orphanages Act, 1958 in its application to the Province of Baluchistan is
hereby repealed.
